# Apipheny

> > Apipheny is a Google Sheets add-on that enables seamless API data import and integration directly into spreadsheets with support for all HTTP methods, authentication, pagination, and scheduling.

Apipheny provides a comprehensive toolkit for connecting APIs to Google Sheets without coding. It supports REST APIs, OAuth 2.0 authentication, multiple HTTP methods, automated scheduling, and batch processing of API requests.

## Key Topics

- Google Sheets
- API Integration
- REST API
- HTTP Methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)
- OAuth 2.0
- JSON Parsing
- API Pagination
- Data Import
- API Scheduling
- Custom Functions
- API Connector
- Spreadsheet Automation
- Response Viewer
- Request Management

## Getting Started

- [Apipheny - API Connector - Google Workspace Marketplace](https://apipheny.io/install): Installation page for Apipheny Google Sheets add-on via Workspace
- [What Is An API & How Do APIs Work?](https://apipheny.io/what-is-an-api): Beginner guide explaining API fundamentals and how APIs work

- [How To Make A HTTP GET API Request](https://apipheny.io/get-request-google-sheets): Tutorial on making HTTP GET requests in Google Sheets with Apipheny

- [PUT, PATCH, & DELETE API Requests](https://apipheny.io/put-patch-delete-google-sheets): Tutorial covering PUT, PATCH, DELETE HTTP methods in Google Sheets
- [How To Get Cell Value In Your Google Sheets API Request](https://apipheny.io/reference-cell-value-api-request): Guide to referencing cell values in Apipheny API requests
- [How To Modify API Request Settings in Apipheny](https://apipheny.io/request-settings): Guide to customizing API request settings in Apipheny
